Welcome to NRI Institute of Technology.

NRI Institute of Technology, popularly known as NRIIT, was established in 2008 in Visadala Village, Andhra Pradesh. It provides quality engineering and management education with modern infrastructure and placement opportunities.
NRI Institute of Technology was established under the leadership of Sri Alapati Ravindra.
NRI Institute of Technology is located at Visadala Road, Perecherla, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh.
NRIIT offers B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, and MCA programs in various departments including CSE, AI & ML, Data Science, ECE, IT, Civil, and VLSI, seminar halls, labs.
Yes, NRIIT offers a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program with focus on software development, programming, AI, and industry-oriented skills.
NRIIT provides placement training, coding practice, aptitude sessions, mock interviews, and recruitment opportunities with reputed companies.
Companies like Infosys, Wipro, IBM, TCS, Capgemini, Deloitte, Virtusa, HCL, and Tech Mahindra have been associated with placements and training activities.
NRIIT provides AI & ML Labs, IoT Labs, Cloud & DevOps Labs, Software Engineering Labs, and advanced computer laboratories.
NRIIT provides modern classrooms, laboratories, auditorium, transport facility, library, canteen, sports grounds, hostel, and power backup.
Yes, hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls with necessary amenities.
NRIIT provides transport facilities covering various routes for students and staff.
NRIIT has a well-equipped library with digital resources, journals, NPTEL content, National Digital Library access, and research materials.
Admissions at NRIIT are based on entrance exams and eligibility criteria prescribed by the authorities and university norms.
NRIIT is an autonomous institution affiliated with JNTUK and approved by AICTE.
The vision of NRIIT is to become a reputed institution producing competitive, ethical, and socially responsible professionals.
NRIIT aims to provide quality education, industry interaction, research opportunities, and development of ethics and leadership skills.
For admissions and enquiries, you can contact NRIIT through the official administration office.
